messages:
Oliver (Acme): Hey — noticed when we apply a second promo via the Admin API it seems to replace the first one instead of stacking. We expected free-trial + promo to both apply. We have the request/response and a short repro.

Oliver (Acme): Repro steps: 1) POST /admin/promos/apply { "org_id": "org_42", "code": "TRIAL50", "source": "portal" } -> 200 OK
2) POST /admin/promos/apply { "org_id": "org_42", "code": "SPRING30", "source": "admin_api" } -> 200 OK
After step 2 balance shows only SPRING30 applied, TRIAL50 gone.

Oliver (Acme): curl we used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/admin/promos/apply \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-XXXX' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"org_id":"org_42","code":"SPRING30","source":"admin_api","request_id":"r123"}'
```

Oliver (Acme): Response body for second call:
```json
{"status":"success","applied":true,"promo_id":"spr30","new_balance":3000}
```

Emma (Support): Sorry about that — thanks for the repro. Can you share the original promo transaction IDs or the two request_ids if you still have them? Also the org_id is enough to look up audit logs.

Oliver (Acme): request_id for TRIAL50 was r122, for SPRING30 was r123. Both in the same minute. I can DM logs if you prefer.

Emma (Support): Please paste the audit entries if possible. Escalating to eng with the rIDs + timestamps.

promo-bot: event: promo.apply succeeded (org_id=org_42, promo_code=SPRING30, request_id=r123)

Raj (Engineering): Looking. Quick hypothesis: the admin API path currently does an upsert on the org_promo row with semantics of 'set latest promo' when there is a metadata collision rather than 'append'. If two apply requests race we may end up with DB state only reflecting the second one. Can you confirm both calls were synchronous (no UI delay)?

Oliver (Acme): Yes they were effectively back-to-back; TRIAL50 was applied via the portal UI and immediately after we ran an automation that called admin API to attach SPRING30.

Raj (Engineering): Thanks — that fits. Can you share the timestamps? I want to reproduce locally. Also any webhook / event order you saw.

Oliver (Acme): TRIAL50 applied at 2024-09-23T15:21:33Z (r122), SPRING30 at 2024-09-23T15:21:42Z (r123).

Raj (Engineering): Repro steps I ran locally: 1) send portal-apply request 2) simultaneously send admin-apply request. Observed the DB upsert SQL:
```sql
INSERT INTO org_promos (org_id, promos, updated_at) VALUES ('org_42', ARRAY['TRIAL50'], now())
ON CONFLICT (org_id) DO UPDATE SET promos = EXCLUDED.promos, updated_at = now();
```
Because we write the array directly (not a merge), the second write overwrites.

Raj (Engineering): Root cause: two different code paths — portal uses a merge/union path that loads, appends and writes back, admin_api currently writes the provided list as-is. Under concurrent writes the last writer wins.

Linda (Billing): To clarify policy: promos are supposed to be additive unless the promo explicitly states "exclusive". Billing data model supports stacking. This is a bug in the apply implementation, not the billing rules.

Emma (Support): Action items: 1) engineering to make admin apply use same merge strategy and make writes idempotent 2) provide immediate mitigation guidance to the customer 3) confirm account balance and restore TRIAL50 if missing.

Oliver (Acme): We need a quick workaround — can you restore TRIAL50? It matters for our trial conversion flows.

Raj (Engineering): Short-term mitigation: we can re-apply TRIAL50 on your org (idempotent apply) and add a safety check to ignore 'set' writes if timestamps are older. Doing a manual re-apply now.

promo-bot: event: promo.apply succeeded (org_id=org_42, promo_code=TRIAL50, request_id=r124)

Linda (Billing): I see both promos now in audit and the customer balance updated. Confirmed TRIAL50 restored (txn tx_9012).

Emma (Support): Sorry again for the disruption. Raj — estimate for a proper fix and rollout?

Raj (Engineering): I'll open a PR to change admin_api apply to perform a merge + compare-and-swap (CAS) update. Estimated timeline: patch in code review today, deploy to staging tomorrow, deploy to prod in 48-72h if tests pass. We'll also add a db migration to store promos as normalized rows (longer-term).

Oliver (Acme): Thanks — can you add a temporary query param we can set from our automation to force merge while fix lands? e.g., ?merge=true

Raj (Engineering): Yep — I can add a compatibility flag on the admin endpoint this afternoon. Use merge=true and include request_id to be safe.

Emma (Support): Workaround summary for customer: 1) re-apply missing promo (done) 2) use merge=true on admin API calls until we release the fix 3) send us any unexpected balances and we'll correct.

Oliver (Acme): Appreciate the fast response. Please tag me on the PR and let me know when merge=true is live. :thumbsup:

Raj (Engineering): Will do. I'll post the PR link and rollout notes when ready.

Emma (Support): Closing the support ticket once prod fix is live and we confirm no other orgs hit this. Leaving thread open for updates. :white_check_mark:
